svg.aria-label: Two charts side by side, one line per data family, models ordered by sensitivity. On the left the angle: on αNLI it falls as the machine grows, on ChatBench it falls with the immediate answer and has no stable trend with reasoning. On the right the person's part of the ideal, which falls in all cases.
